---
title: "Course materials"
---

The course has four modules. Each module page lists its learning
objectives, and has a recorded lecture with a transcript, and the
slides.

- [Module 1: Principles of teaching and learning](modules/module-1-principles-of-teaching-and-learning.qmd)
- [Module 2: Design and plan](modules/module-2-design-and-plan.qmd)
- [Module 3: Learner participation and engagement](modules/module-3-learner-participation-and-engagement.qmd)
- [Module 4: Assessment and feedback](modules/module-4-assessment-and-feedback.qmd)

The course materials are based on those of the
[ELIXIR-GOBLET Train-the-Trainer community](https://elixir-europe.org/platforms/training/train-the-trainer).
